headline: Over 600 shops closed in the Lecco area in 12 years. Confcommercio proposes a permanent roundtable
summary: 616 businesses ceased operating in the Lecco area between 2012 and 2024, 149 of them in the provincial capital. Confcommercio asked the municipality for a permanent dialogue with local operators.
why: Confcommercio is Italy's main business federation for retail, tourism and services. Shop closures reflect pressures on local retail and consumer demand.
